outcome: Near miss related to bleeding during and after caesarean section (BDACS)
Use of interventions to arrest haemorrhage and treat its effects
finding: Near miss cases related to BDACS were frequently associated with pre-operative risk factors and required extensive life-saving interventions.
mod_finding: The realisation by the surgeon that the caesarean section is difficult is an important factor in initiating interventions to prevent progression from uneventful operation to near-miss to death.
